jobPostingInfo.title: Senior Manager Agentic Commerce Advisory & Growth to our team in Stockholm
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
AI agents are starting to reshape how customers discover, compare and buy. We help commerce leaders cut through the hype, make clear decisions and turn the right opportunities into commercial impact.


We're looking for a Senior Manager to accelerate our agentic commerce advisory business. You'll advise senior leaders, shape and sell advisory engagements with account leadership, and turn successful engagements into lasting client relationships, expanded advisory work and relevant transformation programmes across the Netherlands and Nordics.


What you'll do

  • Advise C-level commerce and digital leaders on how AI agents may reshape customer journeys and business models. Challenge assumptions, explain trade-offs and turn uncertainty into clear strategic priorities.
  • Shape agentic commerce strategies, prioritise high-value opportunities and translate them into business cases, operating models and actionable transformation roadmaps.
  • Ground your advice in commerce technology: work with architects and engineers to assess feasibility, data readiness and dependencies without owning solution design.
  • Own the origination, shaping and sale of advisory engagements, sharing sales accountability with account leadership. Work with technology alliance partners to expand successful advisory work into follow-on engagements and relevant transformation programmes.
  • Lead advisory engagements from strategy into execution, staying accountable for quality, client satisfaction and measurable business outcomes while technology and delivery teams lead implementation.
  • Build and evolve our agentic commerce advisory offering, develop a public point of view and coach the consultants around you.

What you bring

  • 10+ years of digital commerce experience, including at least 5 years in client-facing advisory roles at a consultancy and/or agency, advising senior leaders on commerce strategy and transformation.
  • A proven track record in advisory-led business development: identifying opportunities, shaping and closing services engagements, then growing client relationships through successful delivery.
  • Experience structuring ambiguous C-level challenges into clear choices, recommendations, business cases and actionable transformation roadmaps.
  • Strong understanding of commerce technology, from product data and discovery to checkout, and how it connects to the broader martech landscape, including content management, marketing automation, CRM, customer data and personalisation.
  • Credibility with business and technology teams: you can challenge technical assumptions and align specialists, while your focus remains strategic client advice.
  • A well-grounded point of view on agentic commerce, with the ability to assess emerging AI use cases for commercial value, technical feasibility, data readiness and risk.
  • Fluent English. Dutch or a Nordic language is a strong plus.

Why this team

Build on a strong commerce consulting foundation, established client relationships and delivery capabilities, while helping shape the next phase of our agentic commerce advisory offering. You'll have the opportunity to accelerate growth, develop new propositions and expand our impact across the Netherlands and Nordics.


Interested?

Submit your CV, cover letter and diplomas through our application portal. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

About Accenture

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.

Visit us at www.accenture.com
